gaps: ELA GENERIEREN stays enabled during Wird generiert, but the state map never records a click while generation is in flight — whether a second click cancels, replaces or queues is unknown, which is exactly the KF-1 rage-click path.
Variant counter: repeat clicks are recorded only as Variante 1/3 after cycling through 3 distinct texts, so whether the counter tracks the currently displayed variant is unknown.
Library picker records value_read_back empty after a successful pick — the state map does not say whether the reset to bitte waehlen is intended.
No captured state shows the audio zone and the footer SPEICHERN button together in one viewport, so it is unknown whether the audio warning is visible at the moment the user clicks SPEICHERN.

findings.element: ELA · Quelle switched to Library or Voice recording (Gespeicherte Meldung / Aufnahme pickers and the Meldungen state lines)
findings.finding: The picker still reads bitte waehlen while the loaded text is labelled Aus Bibliothek / Mitschrift der Aufnahme with a green check and a ready audio file, so the provenance label and the picker contradict each other.
findings.user_impact: The dispatcher believes they are looking at pre-approved library or human-recorded content with matching audio, and the earlier Uebersetzung nicht aktuell and Audio veraltet warnings disappear without anything having been fixed.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the picker showing the selected entry, and leave the ELA texts and audio row in their previous warned state until an entry is actually selected.

evidence.action: With Quelle=Standard, edited ELA (DE) by hand so DE read Manuell bearbeitet, EN was flagged Uebersetzung nicht aktuell and audio read Audio veraltet; then switched Quelle to Library, then to Voice recording (shots 07 to 08 to 09).
evidence.observed: Shot 08: Gespeicherte Meldung reads bitte waehlen while the text is labelled green Aus Bibliothek in both boxes and the audio line reads Audio erzeugt 12:15 · 0:10 · eine Datei, DE + EN. Shot 09: Aufnahme reads bitte waehlen while the text is labelled Mitschrift der Aufnahme. Both the translation-stale and audio-stale warnings are gone.

findings.element: Footer · SPEICHERN, together with the warning line above the audio row
findings.finding: SPEICHERN stays fully enabled and answers with a bare Meldung gespeichert toast in every unsafe state — stale audio, never-listened audio, Ereignis geaendert, DAISY over 160 characters, and even a completely empty message — so the warning and the confirmation say opposite things.
findings.user_impact: The dispatcher is told the audio does not match the text and that the old version will go to the speakers, and one click later is told the save succeeded, with no way to tell whether the wrong announcement is now live.
findings.suggested_fix: In any warned state require an explicit acknowledgement of that specific warning before saving, and have the toast state what was actually saved.

evidence.action: Clicked SPEICHERN while the audio warning line was showing, then reset the prototype to the empty state and inspected SPEICHERN again.
evidence.observed: Toast Meldung gespeichert, save_blocked false, warning line unchanged, sheet stays open; in the empty state SPEICHERN is still enabled — save_enabled_with_no_message_at_all true. Same with DAISY at 175 characters and in the Ereignis geaendert state.

findings.element: Meldungen · ELA (EN) state line Uebersetzung nicht aktuell
findings.finding: The only signal that the German and English texts have diverged is cleared by typing anything at all into the EN box, with no check that the two texts still say the same thing.
findings.user_impact: One keystroke in EN — even fixing a typo — turns the divergence warning into a reassuring Manuell bearbeitet, so a mismatched pair goes out unflagged in the single combined audio file.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep a persistent pair-level marker that only clears when EN is re-translated from the current DE or the dispatcher explicitly confirms the pair.

evidence.action: Appended a sentence to ELA (DE) so EN was flagged and outlined yellow (shot 05), then typed into the EN box.
evidence.observed: EN state line changed to Manuell bearbeitet, the yellow outline and the divergence warning disappeared, and no comparison of the two languages took place.

findings.element: ELA GENERIEREN and the Wird generiert in-progress state in the ELA boxes
findings.finding: ELA generation shows no spinner or progress indicator and leaves ELA GENERIEREN enabled, while the audio render immediately below it in the same panel does show a progress bar and disables its companion button.
findings.user_impact: With only grey placeholder text as feedback and a live button under the cursor, a dispatcher re-clicks it (the known KF-1 pattern) and then cannot tell whether the second click replaced the first request or produced a different variant.
findings.suggested_fix: Give ELA generation the same progress treatment as the audio render and disable ELA GENERIEREN until it reaches a success or failure state.

evidence.action: Clicked ELA GENERIEREN and captured the in-progress state (shot 03), then compared it with the AUDIO ERZEUGEN in-progress state.
evidence.observed: Both boxes show placeholder Wird generiert and both state lines read Wird generiert, with any_spinner_or_progress = 0 and button_still_enabled_during_generation = true; the audio render by contrast shows progress_bar = 1 and listen_enabled_during_render = false.

findings.element: Error state lines Generierung fehlgeschlagen (ELA) and Sprachdienst nicht erreichbar (audio)
findings.finding: Both failures are announced as a single small caption with no cause, no next step and no retry control, while the box above still displays a plausible older text in completely normal styling.
findings.user_impact: The dispatcher must guess whether to retry, wait, or save without audio, and because the retained previous variant looks exactly like a fresh result they can read a failed generation as a successful one and send outdated wording.
findings.suggested_fix: Put a cause and an inline WIEDERHOLEN action in each error line, and mark the retained content inside the box as the previous version.

evidence.action: Turned the simulated failure on, clicked ELA GENERIEREN, then clicked AUDIO ERZEUGEN.
evidence.observed: Shot 10: both state lines read Generierung fehlgeschlagen while the boxes still show the previous variant with no distinguishing treatment; the audio line reads Sprachdienst nicht erreichbar; retry_affordance recorded as none in the line for both.
